Audit the Boldteq marketing site at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq for EVERY button variant used across the site. I need a complete, precise inventory to build a unified button system.

## Step 1 — Find every button-like element in TSX

Search ALL src/components/**/*.tsx and src/app/**/*.tsx for:
- `<button` elements
- `<Link` elements used as CTAs (classNames containing: btn, button, cta, a-gulf, a-except, skyButton, schedule, book, primary, secondary, ghost, outline)
- `<a href` elements used as buttons (styled as buttons)

For each, record:
- File path + line number
- The className(s) applied
- The visual variant (primary gradient / navy / white ghost / outline / text-link / etc.)
- The size (large, normal, small, pill)

## Step 2 — Extract exact CSS for each button class

Search all src/components/**/*.module.css and src/app/**/*.module.css for classes matching: btn, button, cta, a-gulf, a-except, skyButton, schedule, book, primary, secondary, ghost, outline, submitBtn, tabCta, readBtn, ctaPrimary, ctaSecondary

For each class, extract:
- background / background-image
- color
- font-size / font-weight / line-height / font-family
- padding (shorthand or individual)
- border-radius
- border
- display / align-items / justify-content
- min-height / height
- text-decoration
- transition

## Step 3 — Check Webflow reference

Search boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css for:
- .button-primary, .button-secondary, .button-ghost, .button-primary-large, .button-primary-2, .button-secondary-2, .button-subtle
Extract exact CSS values for each.

## Output format

For Step 1 — BUTTON USAGE TABLE:
```
FILE | LINE | ELEMENT | CLASSNAME | VISUAL_VARIANT | SIZE
```

For Step 2 — CSS VALUES TABLE:
```
CLASSNAME | FILE | bg | color | font-size | font-weight | padding | border-radius | border | min-height
```

For Step 3 — WEBFLOW SPEC TABLE:
```
WEBFLOW_CLASS | bg | color | font-size | font-weight | padding | border-radius | letter-spacing | transition
```

Be exhaustive. Miss nothing. I need every single button across the 21-route site.

**Size Distribution:**
- **Large**: Hero CTAs, major call-to-actions (0.75rem padding + 1rem font)
- **Medium**: Secondary CTAs, cards (0.75rem/1rem hybrid)
- **Small**: Navbars, form buttons, utilities (8px—13px font)
